text.description_html:
Wilmington Exterior Trim Kit with Egg Knob

The Baldwin made Wilmington Mortise Exterior Tim Set has a classic design that will look beautiful in any traditional home. It comes packaged with exterior mortise trim plate , 1 inch mortise cylinder, and egg knob. The tough PVD Polished Brass Finish is backed by a lifetime warranty and is great for harsh climates such as extreme heat or salty environments.

Features of the Wilmington Exterior Trim Kit:

  • Made of solid forged brass.

Specifications of the Classic Estate Collection Wilmington Outside Trim Set:

  • Finish: PVD Polished Brass
  • Trim: 5025 Egg Knob
  • Length: 10"
  • Width: 2-3/4"
  • Thickness: .281"
  • Knob Length: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Width: 1-1/2"
  • Overall Projection: 2.87"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" or 1-3/8"

Sold Individually
